articles.title: Why risk management comes first
articles.summary: Entries get attention, but position size decides who survives.
articles.body:
## The one rule

Risk a **small, fixed percent** of capital on every trade. Most blown accounts come from oversized positions, not bad analysis.

### A simple checklist

- Decide the stop-loss before the entry
- Size the position from the stop distance
- Never add to a losing trade

> Protect capital first. Profits are a by-product of staying in the game.
